name: issue_637_paused_during_grace_open_fallthrough
description: [Superseded by Issue #1142 -- the final assertion now expects a pause, see the first note.] Confirms grace periods genuinely hold through this exact fallthrough path in production, not just as a static-trace hypothesis (Issue #637/#655, Block 5 Phase R Step 3). Sensor opens while hot (pauses HVAC), closes (resumes + starts a 10-min automation grace period), a cool front moves in, then the sensor reopens while grace is STILL active. Before the #655 fix, handle_door_window_open()'s grace guard only suppressed the pause using a coarse outdoor-only proxy -- when outdoor looked cool enough, execution fell through past the guard to the real (indoor-and-outdoor) nat-vent gate, and if THAT gate then failed, the fallthrough paused HVAC anyway, silently defeating the grace period the occupant was just given. The #655 fix makes the grace guard share the same real gate result the fallthrough already computes, so a reopen during grace that the real gate says isn't nat-vent-viable now correctly stays suppressed -- HVAC keeps running, uninterrupted, exactly as a 'grace period' should behave. Occupant impact: before the fix, briefly reopening a door mid-grace-window could pause the AC/heat anyway; after the fix, it can't.
notes: Issue #1537 (owner-approved golden change; re-derived 2026-11-13, owner approved: harness thermostats report hvac_action (#1537)): the thermostat reports cooling from 13:00 (CA resumes cool 74 F with the room at 76 F, past its 75.5 F start point). At 13:05 the room reading drops to 71 F; the AC stops on that reading, so production's settling guard sees 'cooling ran 0 min ago' and holds the floor-breach heat arming (comfort_switch_held, zone breach, 1 F deep inside the 5 F tolerance) instead of set_hvac_mode heat + heat 72 F. At 13:07 the reopened window pauses from cool (cool->off) instead of from heat (heat->off). The 13:08 'paused' assertion this golden protects is unchanged. (a) Effectiveness: unchanged, the pause/grace assertions fail as before when the #655/#1142 logic is reverted. (b) Docs<->production: comfort-edge-selection-spec R1-R3 (a breach inside the tolerance is held while the opposite side ran within the window) and sim-harness-spec match production. (c) Occupant: on a 90 F day the furnace is not armed the moment the AC stops after a cool front; the window pause still happens.

Issue #1142 (owner-approved golden change): rule 3 -- the only exception to 'no heat/cool with a window open after the debounce' is the occupant's manual override. Climate Advisor's own automation grace is not one, so it no longer holds off the pause: a window open past the debounce inside it gets the same answer as outside a grace (start nat-vent if the nat-vent FSM allows it, otherwise pause). Superseded by this note: the final 13:08 assertion is now 'paused'; the description below and the older notes describe the #655-era hold and are historical.

Exercises the exact fallthrough path #655 was filed against: handle_door_window_open()'s `if self._grace_active:` guard (automation.py ~L2889) now shares the same real _nat_vent_may_reactivate() gate result the nat-vent-vs-pause decision further down the function uses, instead of a coarse outdoor-only proxy. When that shared gate fails, the grace-active branch returns immediately (not pausing) rather than falling through to a second, independently-computed gate that could disagree.

use_coordinator=true so the real _async_door_window_changed listener drives debounce/pause/resume/grace exactly as production does (sensor_debounce_seconds default is 0 in the harness, so debounce is effectively instant).

comfort_heat=72 (unusually high) is deliberate: at the 13:07 reopen, indoor=71 is BELOW comfort_heat=72, so decide_nat_vent_gate()'s floor check (indoor > comfort_heat) fails even though outdoor(60) is otherwise nat-vent-favorable (cool, below threshold) -- this is exactly the shape of disagreement the old coarse proxy could miss, and the fixed shared-gate check correctly still suppresses on.
automation_grace_seconds=600 (10 min) gives enough room between the 13:00 resume and the 13:07 reopen for grace to still be active (expires 13:10).

Before the #655 fix, this scenario's final assertion was 'paused_during_grace' (the bug: HVAC paused anyway, grace silently defeated). It is now 'resumed' (the fix: grace holds, no pause) -- updated 2026-08-16 with explicit user sign-off per the Golden Simulation Test Policy, since #655's fix is what this scenario now exists to prove.

events.note: Hot afternoon. Indoor above comfort_cool=74F. Outdoor too warm for nat vent.
Hot-day classification: HVAC cool at 74F (classifier.py derives cool for a hot day).
Back door opens. Outdoor 88F > threshold 77F -- nat vent ineligible. Automation pauses (HVAC was actively cooling).
Door closes. All sensors closed -- automation resumes (restores cool mode) and a 10-min automation grace period begins (expires 13:10).
A cool front moves in. Outdoor drops to 60F (below the 77F nat-vent threshold), but indoor has also settled to 71F -- just BELOW comfort_heat=72F.

Door reopens at 13:07, while the 13:00 grace period is still active (expires 13:10). The real reactivation gate (outdoor 60F is favorable, but indoor 71F is not above comfort_heat 72F) fails, so the grace guard now correctly suppresses -- grace holds, HVAC stays resumed, no pause.

No-op re-assertion of the same readings -- purely to advance the fake scheduler past 13:07 so the debounce-triggered handle_door_window_open() dispatch from the reopen above has actually settled before the assertion below reads final state (same pattern as the sibling grace_full_lifecycle_sensor_still_open.json golden's trailing no-op dispatch).

assertions.reason: Sensor opens with outdoor (88F) far above the nat-vent threshold -- automation pauses.
All sensors closed -- automation resumes and starts a 10-min automation grace period.

Issue #1142 (rule 3): the sensor reopens while Climate Advisor's own automation grace is still active. The real reactivation gate fails (indoor 71F is not above comfort_heat 72F, even though outdoor 60F is otherwise favorable), so the answer is the same as outside a grace: pause. The automation grace is not a manual override and no longer holds the pause (previously 'resumed' -- the #655 fix made the grace share the gate result and hold). The grace and the start decision cannot disagree any more: both read one nat-vent FSM answer.
